Handicapper caught out out by Louise Continual rain throughout the day resulted in a much smaller field than has been normal in the last few years but one runner who wasn't going to be put off by the conditions was 12 year old Louise Collier who sprang an almighty surprise on the handicapper.
Louise Collier was outstanding in the under 13 event. It was the shortest race of the day but her winning margin of 47 seconds was the largest in all of the races.

As the first of three of the Belles marathon team to go out on the course there was interest in whether Louise Cooper would find the extra training beneficial or whether the marathon would have tired her out.
